summary: QUALCOMM filed an 8-K disclosing a prospectus supplement for the resale of 17,826,566 shares of common stock issued as consideration for its acquisition of Modular Inc., announced June 21, 2026. The shares were issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506, with a Registration Rights Agreement dated July 28, 2026, with Shareholder Representative Services LLC. No price per share or premium was stated. Paul, Weiss advised on legality. Watch for the Modular deal's closing and any overhang from the registered resale.
